review.rationale: The patch introduces critical schema/status mirror drift by adding 38 new fields to PROGRAM-STATUS.md without updating the corresponding schema definition, which will cause schema validation failures. Additionally, the TITMAS-COMMERCIALIZATION-STANDARDS-ENTRY-v0.1.json contains obsolete status and option values that do not reflect the current immutable candidate validation authorization state, creating Recommendation/Decision/Execution confusion. The README.md additions, while comprehensive, suffer from agent-readability defects due to dense narrative formatting. These issues must be corrected before the patch can be approved for integration.
